facts.fact: Radio Tamazuj reports the country lacks a comprehensive data protection law, and a digital expert at the Excellence Foundation says South Sudan has no data protection laws in place at the moment.

Radio Tamazuj reports that in October 2025 digital security experts finalised drafting the country's first Data Protection Policy Bill, facilitated by Koneta and Paradigm Initiative with the NCA and civil society.
Radio Tamazuj reports that the draft bill, when passed, will establish a Data Protection Commission to safeguard the personal data of South Sudanese online users.

systems.owner: drafted by Koneta Initiative and Paradigm Initiative with the NCA
